header: Week of Monday 16 November 2026 — built 2026-11-16 from 145 daily snapshots (2026-06-17 to 2026-11-16), 5,326 pieces with a price record across 216 labels.
286 pieces changed price and 27 of those moves are confirmed by a later snapshot; the biggest is 44% at Nokshi New York.

Prices can only be compared over 4 snapshots this week, so every price story is held; 299 pieces down to one or two sizes and 775 listed by their shop in the last 7 days are what the record supports today.

notes: Lowest-ever prices, brand price discipline ("this label discounts N%") and "this price has held" are all HELD this week. price_records.json measures those inside the current pricing epoch, and the 2026-11-10 change plus its 3-day settle leaves only 4 comparable snapshots (2026-11-13 to 2026-11-16). Quoting them would be a statement about 4 days dressed up as one about 145. They come back on 2026-11-26 at the earliest.

No price claim is made about 28natelier, Anna October, Blanch Wear, Christopher Esber, Donde Esteban, My Mum Made It, Sir the Label, With Jéan: price_corrections.json still has an open FX repair window for each of them, which is that file's own statement that it does not vouch for those prices.

The Chicago story is a piece stocked by Gemini, 1911 W. Division St., Chicago, IL 60622 — the label itself is not Chicago-based, and the sheet does not say it is. brands.json has no city field on any label entry, so a Chicago DESIGNER cannot be identified from this data.
No story of these kinds was available: lowest (lowest price on our record), hold (a price that will not move).
